scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run build:api" "npm run build:web"
scripts.test: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run test:api" "npm run test:web"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm run generate:key
